audience: managers and HR staff who plan shifts and staff availability in Bedrijfsrooster

useCases.title: Review the timetable for the coming week
useCases.text: Read the company setup, then list the timetable shifts for the coming week. Choose the kinds to include, such as work shifts or relief.

useCases.title: Spot days with too few people available
useCases.text: Get the availability per employee or per function for up to 31 days. Find the days with too few people available. The integration needs the availability read permission.

useCases.title: List the employment contracts active today
useCases.text: List the employment contracts that are active today or within a period. Then list the employees to check their current employment.

useCases.title: Review the staff list for a period
useCases.text: List the employees with an active or future employment, optionally within a period. Ask for personal details only when you need them.

useCases.title: Read a finished report
useCases.text: Get the stored result of a finished report by its report id, such as the relief hours balance. If the report still runs, check again later. The integration needs the reports read permission.
